scripts.title: Emote freezer
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Удаляем старую кнопку, если она уже была создана ранее
for _, oldGui in ipairs({player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"), game:GetService("CoreGui")}) do
    if oldGui then
        local existing = oldGui:FindFirstChild("FreezeAnimGui_Ultra")
        if existing then existing:Destroy() end
    end
end

-- ================= 1. МГНОВЕННОЕ СОЗДАНИЕ КНОПКИ =================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FreezeAnimGui_Ultra"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 999999

-- Самый надежный метод добавления GUI на экран
local targetParent = nil
if gethui then
    pcall(function() targetParent = gethui() end)
end
if not targetParent then
    pcall(function() targetParent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
end
if not targetParent then
    targetParent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 3) or player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

screenGui.Parent = targetParent

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "FreezeBtn"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
-- Позиция: Центр экрана в верхней части
toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0.15, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggleBtn.Text = "❄️ Заморозить"
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggleBtn.TextSize = 16
toggleBtn.Active = true
toggleBtn.Draggable = true
toggleBtn.ZIndex = 1000
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
UICorner.Parent = toggleBtn

local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
UIStroke.Thickness = 2
UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
UIStroke.Parent = toggleBtn
-- =================================================================

-- ================= 2. ЛОГИКА ЗАМОРОЗКИ =================
local lastPlayedTrack = nil
local frozenTrack = nil
local frozenTime = 0
local isFrozen = false
local heartbeatConnection = nil
local animConnections = {}

local ignoredWords = {"walk", "run", "idle", "jump", "fall", "swim", "climb", "strafe"}

local function getHumanoid()
    local char = player.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function isMovementAnim(track)
    if not track then return false end
    local name = string.lower(track.Name or "")
    for _, word in ipairs(ignoredWords) do
        if string.find(name, word) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function isSameAnimation(track1, track2)
    if not track1 or not track2 then return false end
    if track1 == track2 then return true end
    
    local id1 = track1.Animation and track1.Animation.AnimationId
    local id2 = track2.Animation and track2.Animation.AnimationId
    return (id1 and id2 and id1 ~= "" and id1 == id2)
end

local function hookAnimator(targetAnimator)
    if not targetAnimator then return end
    local conn = targetAnimator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
        if not isFrozen and not isMovementAnim(track) then
            lastPlayedTrack = track
        end
    end)
    table.insert(animConnections, conn)
end

local function setupAllAnimatorsHook()
    for _, conn in ipairs(animConnections) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
    animConnections = {}
    
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        local conn = hum.EmotePlayed:Connect(function(_, track)
            if not isFrozen and track then
                lastPlayedTrack = track
            end
        end)
        table.insert(animConnections, conn)
    end
    
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Animator") then
            hookAnimator(obj)
        end
    end
    
    local addConn = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if obj:IsA("Animator") then
            hookAnimator(obj)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(animConnections, addConn)
end

task.spawn(setupAllAnimatorsHook)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    setupAllAnimatorsHook()
    if isFrozen then
        isFrozen = false
        frozenTrack = nil
        toggleBtn.Text = "❄️ Заморозить"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    end
end)

local function getActiveTrack()
    if lastPlayedTrack and (lastPlayedTrack.IsPlaying or lastPlayedTrack.TimePosition > 0) then
        return lastPlayedTrack
    end
    
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    
    local allTracks = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Animator") or obj:IsA("Humanoid") or obj:IsA("AnimationController") then
            pcall(function()
                for _, trk in ipairs(obj:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    table.insert(allTracks, trk)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    
    for i = #allTracks, 1, -1 do
        local trk = allTracks[i]
        if trk.IsPlaying and not isMovementAnim(trk) then
            return trk
        end
    end
    
    for i = #allTracks, 1, -1 do
        local trk = allTracks[i]
        if trk.IsPlaying then
            return trk
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

local function toggleFreeze()
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if not char or not hum then return end
    
    if not isFrozen then
        local targetTrack = getActiveTrack()
        
        if not targetTrack then
            local oldText = toggleBtn.Text
            toggleBtn.Text = "❌ Включи эмоцию!"
            toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 100, 0)
            
            task.delay(1.5, function()
                if not isFrozen then
                    toggleBtn.Text = oldText
                    toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
                end
            end)
            return
        end
        
        frozenTrack = targetTrack
        frozenTime = frozenTrack.TimePosition
        if frozenTime <= 0 then frozenTime = 0.1 end
        
        isFrozen = true
        
        pcall(function()
            frozenTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        end)
        
        local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if animateScript then
            animateScript.Disabled = true
        end
        
        for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Animator") or obj:IsA("Humanoid") or obj:IsA("AnimationController") then
                pcall(function()
                    for _, trk in ipairs(obj:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        if not isSameAnimation(trk, frozenTrack) then
                            trk:Stop(0)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        
        frozenTrack:AdjustSpeed(0)
        frozenTrack.TimePosition = frozenTime
        
        toggleBtn.Text = "🔥 Разморозить"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
        
        if heartbeatConnection then heartbeatConnection:Disconnect() end
        heartbeatConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not isFrozen or not frozenTrack then return end
            
            pcall(function()
                if not frozenTrack.IsPlaying then
                    frozenTrack:Play(0, 1, 0)
                end
                frozenTrack:AdjustSpeed(0)
                frozenTrack.TimePosition = frozenTime
            end)
            
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false
                if hum.WalkSpeed == 0 then
                    hum.WalkSpeed = 16
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if heartbeatConnection then
            heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
            heartbeatConnection = nil
        end
        
        if frozenTrack then
            pcall(function()
                frozenTrack:AdjustSpeed(1)
                frozenTrack:Stop(0)
            end)
            frozenTrack = nil
        end
        
        local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if animateScript then
            animateScript.Disabled = false
        end
        
        isFrozen = false
        toggleBtn.Text = "❄️ Заморозить"
        toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    end
end

toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFreeze)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.G then
        toggleFreeze()
    end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if isFrozen and hum and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
        hum.Jump = true
    end
end)

scripts.title: Admin panel
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Hacker Menu | 30 Toggles de Jugador",
   LoadingTitle = "Cargando Módulos de Toggles...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Universal Hacker",
   ConfigurationSaving = {
      Enabled = false,
      FolderName = "HackerTogglesMenu",
      FileName = "Config"
   },
   KeySystem = false, 
})

local Tab1 = Window:CreateTab("Toggles 1-15", 4483362458)
local Tab2 = Window:CreateTab("Toggles 16-30", 4483362458)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

---------------------------------------------------
-- SECCIÓN 1: TOGGLES 1 AL 15
---------------------------------------------------

Tab1:CreateSection("Modificaciones Activas (1 - 15)")

-- 1. WalkSpeed
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "1. Super Velocidad (WalkSpeed 100)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle1 = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while getgenv().Toggle1 do
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
               LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
         end
         if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 2. JumpPower
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "2. Super Salto (JumpPower 150)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle2 = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while getgenv().Toggle2 do
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
               LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 150
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
         end
         if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 3. Noclip
local noclipConn
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "3. Noclip (Atravesar Paredes)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      if Value then
         noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if LocalPlayer.Character then
               for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                  if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                     part.CanCollide = false
                  end
               end
            end
         end)
      else
         if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() end
      end
   end,
})

-- 4. Infinite Jump
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "4. Salto Infinito en el Aire",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle4 = Value
      UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
         if getgenv().Toggle4 and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 5. Godmode Falso
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "5. Godmode (Regeneración de Vida)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle5 = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while getgenv().Toggle5 do
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if hum then
               hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 6. Vuelo Noclip
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "6. Vuelo Libre con Cámara",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle6 = Value
      local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if Value and root then
         local bp = Instance.new("BodyPosition", root)
         bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
         bp.Position = root.Position
         task.spawn(function()
            while getgenv().Toggle6 do
               bp.Position = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position + (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * 50)
               task.wait()
            end
            bp:Destroy()
         end)
      end
   end,
})

-- 7. Invisibilidad Local
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "7. Invisibilidad de Avatar",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      local char = LocalPlayer.Character
      if char then
         for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then
               part.Transparency = Value and 1 or 0
            end
         end
      end
   end,
})

-- 8. Arcoíris en Partes
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "8. Efecto Color Arcoíris en Ropa",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle8 = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while getgenv().Toggle8 do
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
               for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                  if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                     part.Color = Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 5 / 5, 1, 1)
                  end
               end
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 9. SpinBot Visual
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "9. Giro Constante (SpinBot)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle9 = Value
      local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if Value and root then
         local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", root)
         bav.Name = "SpinBotToggle"
         bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
         bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 150, 0)
         task.spawn(function()
            while getgenv().Toggle9 do task.wait(0.1) end
            if root:FindFirstChild("SpinBotToggle") then
               root.SpinBotToggle:Destroy()
            end
         end)
      end
   end,
})

-- 10. Cabeza Gigante (Hitbox Visual)
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "10. Cabeza Gigante Extrema",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      local char = LocalPlayer.Character
      if char and char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
         if Value then
            char.Head.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
            char.Head.CanCollide = false
         else
            char.Head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
         end
      end
   end,
})

-- 11. Gravedad Cero Personal
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "11. Gravedad Baja (Flotar Leve)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      workspace.Gravity = Value and 30 or 196.2
   end,
})

-- 12. Fullbright / Visión Nocturna
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "12. Visión Nocturna Completa",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      if Value then
         Lighting.Brightness = 3
         Lighting.ClockTime = 12
         Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
      else
         Lighting.Brightness = 1
         Lighting.ClockTime = 14
         Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
      end
   end,
})

-- 13. FOV Extendido de Hacker
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "13. Campo de Visión Amplio (FOV 120)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = Value and 120 or 70
   end,
})

-- 14. Anti-AFK
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "14. Anti-AFK (Evitar Patada por Inactividad)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle14 = Value
      local vu = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
      LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
         if getgenv().Toggle14 then
            vu:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0,0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
            task.wait(1)
            vu:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0,0), workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 15. Brillo de Personaje (Highlight Propio)
Tab1:CreateToggle({
   Name = "15. Aura Brillante en el Personaje",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      local char = LocalPlayer.Character
      if char then
         if Value then
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "SelfHighlightHacker"
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
            hl.Parent = char
         else
            if char:FindFirstChild("SelfHighlightHacker") then
               char.SelfHighlightHacker:Destroy()
            end
         end
      end
   end,
})


---------------------------------------------------
-- SECCIÓN 2: TOGGLES 16 AL 30
---------------------------------------------------

Tab2:CreateSection("Modificaciones Activas (16 - 30)")

-- 16. Bloqueo de Posición (Anclar)
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "16. Congelar Mi Posición (Anchor)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if root then
         root.Anchored = Value
      end
   end,
})

-- 17. Modo Espectador Automático Cercano
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "17. Cambiar Cámara a Primera Persona Forzada",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      LocalPlayer.CameraMode = Value and Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson or Enum.CameraMode.Classic
   end,
})

-- 18. Auto-Clicker de Herramienta
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "18. Auto-Clicker Constante",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle18 = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while getgenv().Toggle18 do
            local tool = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then tool:Activate() end
            task.wait(0.05)
         end
      end)
   end,
})

-- 19. Eliminar Niebla del Mapa
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "19. Eliminar Toda la Niebla del Entorno",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
         if v:IsA("Atmosphere") or v:IsA("Fog") then
            v.Parent = Value and nil or Lighting
         end
      end
   end,
})

-- 20. Desactivar Colisiones de Accesorios (Sombreros/Pelo)
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "20. Desactivar Colisión de Accesorios",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      local char = LocalPlayer.Character
      if char then
         for _, accessory in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
               local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
               if handle then handle.CanCollide = not Value end
            end
         end
      end
   end,
})

-- 21. Efecto de Suspensión en el Aire (Flotar estático)
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "21. Plataforma Invisible Bajo los Pies",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      local root = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if Value and root then
         local p = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
         p.Name = "FloatPlatformHacker"
         p.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
         p.Transparency = 1
         p.Anchored = true
         p.CFrame = root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
         task.spawn(function()
            while root and workspace:FindFirstChild("FloatPlatformHacker") do
               p.CFrame = root.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
               task.wait()
            end
         end)
      else
         if workspace:FindFirstChild("FloatPlatformHacker") then
            workspace.FloatPlatformHacker:Destroy()
         end
      end
   end,
})

-- 22. Rotación de Cámara Lenta Automática
Tab2:CreateToggle({
   Name = "22. Giro Lento de Cámara Automático",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      getgenv().Toggle22 = Value
      task.spawn(function()
         while getgenv().Toggle22 do
            workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(1), 0)
